const noiseGLSL = `
float nwbHash(vec3 p){
  p = fract(p * 0.1031);
  p += dot(p, p.yzx + 33.33);
  return fract((p.x + p.y) * p.z);
}
float nwbNoise(vec3 p){
  vec3 i = floor(p);
  vec3 f = fract(p);
  f = f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);
  return mix(
    mix(mix(nwbHash(i),nwbHash(i+vec3(1,0,0)),f.x),
        mix(nwbHash(i+vec3(0,1,0)),nwbHash(i+vec3(1,1,0)),f.x),f.y),
    mix(mix(nwbHash(i+vec3(0,0,1)),nwbHash(i+vec3(1,0,1)),f.x),
        mix(nwbHash(i+vec3(0,1,1)),nwbHash(i+vec3(1,1,1)),f.x),f.y),f.z);

function surfaceMaterial(color, mode) {
  const mat = standard(color, mode === 'wood' ? 0.73 : 0.94);
  let bodyPatch = '';
  if (mode === 'left-belly' || mode === 'right-belly') {
    const left = mode === 'left-belly';
    const cx = left ? -60 : 83;
    const cy = left ? -56 : -56;
    const rx = left ? 43 : 39;
    const ry = left ? 36 : 38;

    float grain = nwbNoise(vec3(nwbP.x*0.026,nwbP.y*0.032,nwbP.z*0.36+warp));

    shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.replace(
      '#include <color_fragment>',

}

function radialTexture() {
  const size = 32, pixels = new Uint8Array(size * size * 4);
  for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      const r = Math.hypot((x + 0.5 - size / 2) / (size / 2), (y + 0.5 - size / 2) / (size / 2));
      const alpha = Math.max(0, 1 - r * r);
      const i = (x + y * size) * 4;
      pixels.set([56, 34, 20, Math.round(255 * alpha * alpha * alpha)], i);
    }
  }
  const map = new THREE.DataTexture(pixels, size, size);
  map.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  map.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  map.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  map.needsUpdate = true;
  return map;
}

function geometry(vertices, indices) {
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
  g.setIndex(indices);
  g.computeVertexNormals();

}
function gridGeometry(fn, nu, nv, reverse) {
  const vertices = [], indices = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= nv; j++) {
    for (let i = 0; i <= nu; i++) vertices.push(...fn(i / nu, j / nv).toArray());
  }
  for (let j = 0; j < nv; j++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < nu; i++) {
      const a = j * (nu + 1) + i, b = a + 1, c = a + nu + 1, d = c + 1;
      indices.push(...(reverse ? [a, c, b, b, c, d] : [a, b, c, b, d, c]));
    }
  }
  return geometry(vertices, indices);
}

function openBook(name, spine, leftEdge, rightEdge, bend, paper) {
  const book = group(name, desk, onTable(...spine[1]));
  const corners = pair => pair.map(q => onTable(...q));
  const hinge = corners(spine);
  for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
    const edge = corners(side < 0 ? leftEdge : rightEdge);
    const leaf = group(side < 0 ? 'left-page-block' : 'right-page-block', book, hinge[0]);
    function page(u, v, layer = 0, spread = 0) {
      const inner = hinge[0].clone().lerp(hinge[1], v);
      const outer = edge[0].clone().lerp(edge[1], v);
      const p = inner.lerp(outer, u * (1 + spread));
      const curl = Math.sin(Math.PI * u) ** 1.15;
      const swell = 0.82 + 0.34 * Math.cos(Math.PI * (v - 0.18));
      p.y += 2.9 + curl * (side < 0 ? bend[0] : bend[1]) * swell
        + u * (0.53 + 0.30 * Math.cos(Math.PI * v)) + layer;
      p.z -= 1.35 * curl * (1 - v);
      return p;
    }
    mesh(leaf, 'underlying cover', gridGeometry((u, v) => page(u, v, -2.36, 0.032),
      20, 12, side > 0), bookCover, origin, false);
    const rimSegments = [
      st => [st, 1], st => [1, st], st => [st, 0]
    ];
    for (const [rim, coords] of rimSegments.entries()) {
      for (let i = 0; i < pageEdges.length; i++) {
        const lower = -2.32 + i * 0.58;
        const band = gridGeometry((st, h) => {
          const [u, v] = coords(st);
          return page(u, v, lower + h * 0.58, (1 - (i + h) / 4) * 0.027);
        }, 22, 1, false);
        mesh(leaf, `paper edges ${rim + 1}.${i + 1}`, band, pageEdges[i], origin, false);
      }
    }
    mesh(leaf, 'curved top sheet', gridGeometry((u, v) => page(u, v), 35, 19, side > 0),
      paper, origin, false);
    if (side > 0) {
      mesh(leaf, 'binding crease', gridGeometry((u, v) => page(u * 0.018, v, 0.036),
        2, 24, true), bindingMat, origin, false);
    }
  }
  return book;
}

function hermite(a, b, slopeA, slopeB, t) {
  const tt = t * t, ttt = tt * t;
  return (2 * ttt - 3 * tt + 1) * a + (ttt - 2 * tt + t) * slopeA
    + (-2 * ttt + 3 * tt) * b + (ttt - tt) * slopeB;
}

function sculptBody(character, controls, neck, skin) {
  const bands = 72, ringsPerStep = 5;
  const vertices = [], indices = [];
  for (let seg = 0; seg < controls.length - 1; seg++) {
    const a = controls[seg], b = controls[seg + 1];
    const back = controls[Math.max(0, seg - 1)];
    const next = controls[Math.min(controls.length - 1, seg + 2)];
    const distance = b[0] - a[0];
    const last = seg === controls.length - 2 ? ringsPerStep : ringsPerStep - 1;
    for (let r = 0; r <= last; r++) {
      const t = r / ringsPerStep;
      const fields = [];
      for (let k = 1; k <= 4; k++) {
        fields.push(hermite(a[k], b[k],
          (b[k] - back[k]) * distance / (b[0] - back[0]),
          (next[k] - a[k]) * distance / (next[0] - a[0]), t));
      }
      const [x, z, rx, rz] = fields, y = a[0] + distance * t;
      for (let k = 0; k < bands; k++) {
        const phase = 2 * Math.PI * k / bands;
        vertices.push(x - 120 + Math.sin(phase) * Math.max(0, rx), y,
          z + Math.cos(phase) * Math.max(0, rz));
      }
    }
  }
  const count = vertices.length / (bands * 3);
  for (let r = 0; r < count - 1; r++) {
    for (let k = 0; k < bands; k++) {
      const a = r * bands + k, b = r * bands + (k + 1) % bands;
      indices.push(a, b, a + bands, b, b + bands, a + bands);
    }
  }
  const all = geometry(vertices, indices);
  const normals = all.attributes.normal.array;
  const cut = neck * ringsPerStep;
  const joint = controls[neck];
  const torso = group('torso', character);
  const head = group('head', character, new THREE.Vector3(joint[1] - 120, joint[0], joint[2]));
  function piece(first, after) {
    const start = first * bands, end = (after + 1) * bands;
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices.slice(start * 3, end * 3), 3));
    g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.BufferAttribute(normals.slice(start * 3, end * 3), 3));
    g.setIndex(indices.slice(first * bands * 6, after * bands * 6).map(i => i - start));
    return g;
  }
  const torsoMesh = mesh(torso, 'soft torso and belly', piece(0, cut), skin, origin);
  const headMesh = mesh(head, 'soft rounded head', piece(cut, count - 1), skin, origin);
  return { head, surfaces: [torsoMesh, headMesh] };
}

const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
function pickSurface(body, x, y) {
  for (const shift of [0, 1, -1, 2.5, -2.5, 4, -4]) {
    raycaster.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(x / 120 - 1, 1 - y / 121), ref);
    raycaster.ray.origin.x += shift;
    const hit = raycaster.intersectObjects(body.surfaces, false)[0];
    if (hit) {
      const normal = (hit.normal || hit.face.normal).clone().transformDirection(hit.object.matrixWorld);
      return { depth: hit.point.dot(view), normal };
    }
  }
  return { depth: -51, normal: view.clone() };
}

function eyePiece(g, name, position, scale, mat) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(unitSphere, mat);
  m.name = name;
  g.add(m);
  m.position.set(...position);
  m.scale.set(...scale);
  return m;
}

function makeEye(body, parent, name, x, y, rx, ry, dx, dy, turn, bias) {
  const hit = pickSurface(body, x, y);
  const forward = hit.normal.lerp(view, bias).normalize();
  const across = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(screenUp, forward).normalize();
  const up = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(forward, across).normalize();
  const g = group(name, parent, point(x, y, hit.depth + 0.85));
  g.quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(across, up, forward));
  g.rotateZ(turn);
  eyePiece(g, 'recess around eye', [0, 0, -1.36], [rx + 0.86, ry + 0.7, 2.65], eyeSocket);
  eyePiece(g, 'charcoal eye dome', [0, 0, -0.03], [rx, ry, rx * 0.50 + 0.38], eyeOuter);
  const gaze = group('pupil and iris', g);
  gaze.position.set(dx, dy, rx * 0.36);
  gaze.rotation.y = dx * 0.10;
  gaze.rotation.x = -dy * 0.075;
  eyePiece(gaze, 'iris', [0, 0, 0.05], [rx * 0.68, ry * 0.71, rx * 0.25], iris);
  eyePiece(gaze, 'pupil', [0.20, -0.24, rx * 0.166], [rx * 0.48, ry * 0.55, rx * 0.13], pupil);
  eyePiece(gaze, 'soft catchlight', [-rx * 0.244, ry * 0.265, rx * 0.275],
    [rx * 0.141, ry * 0.12, 0.48], catchlight);
}

function mouth(body, name, knots, color, lipColor) {
  const mid = knots[Math.floor(knots.length / 2)];
  const g = group(name, body.head, point(mid[0], mid[1], pickSurface(body, mid[0], mid[1]).depth));
  const track = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(knots.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(...p)), false, 'catmullrom');
  function ribbon(offset, lip) {
    return gridGeometry((u, v) => {
      const k = track.getPoint(u);
      const width = Math.max(0.16, k.z - k.y);
      const y = lip ? k.z - 0.17 + v * (0.35 + width * 0.34) : k.y + v * width;
      return point(k.x, y, pickSurface(body, k.x, y).depth + offset);
    }, 30, 3, false);
  }
  mesh(g, 'lower-lip contour', ribbon(0.34, true),
    standard(lipColor, 0.96, { side: THREE.DoubleSide }), origin, false, false);
  mesh(g, 'mouth opening', ribbon(0.71, false),
    standard(color, 0.97, { side: THREE.DoubleSide }), origin, false, false);
}

function sweep(parent, name, path, mat, ellipticity = 0.90) {
  const points = path.map(p => point(p[0], p[1], p[2]));
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points, false, 'catmullrom', 0.5);
  const sides = 26, lengthSteps = Math.max(21, (path.length - 1) * 10);
  const vertices = [], faces = [];
  function radius(t) {
    const pos = t * (path.length - 1);
    const i = Math.min(path.length - 2, Math.floor(pos));
    const a = path[i][3], b = path[i + 1][3];
    const before = path[Math.max(0, i - 1)][3];
    const after = path[Math.min(path.length - 1, i + 2)][3];
    return Math.max(0.025, hermite(a, b, 0.5 * (b - before), 0.5 * (after - a), pos - i));
  }
  for (let j = 0; j <= lengthSteps; j++) {
    const t = j / lengthSteps;
    const at = curve.getPoint(t);
    const tangent = curve.getTangent(t);
    const across = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(tangent, view);
    if (across.lengthSq() < 0.00001) across.crossVectors(tangent, screenUp);
    across.normalize();
    const other = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(tangent, across);
    const r = radius(t);
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = (i / sides) * 2 * Math.PI;
      const p = at.clone().addScaledVector(across, r * Math.cos(a))
        .addScaledVector(other, r * ellipticity * Math.sin(a));
      vertices.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
    }
  }
  for (let j = 0; j < lengthSteps; j++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = j * sides + i, b = j * sides + (i + 1) % sides;
      faces.push(a, b, a + sides, b, b + sides, a + sides);
    }
  }
  const tipIndex = vertices.length / 3;
  vertices.push(...points[0].toArray(), ...points.at(-1).toArray());
  for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
    const k = (i + 1) % sides, end = lengthSteps * sides;
    faces.push(tipIndex, k, i, tipIndex + 1, end + i, end + k);
  }
  return mesh(parent, name, geometry(vertices, faces), mat, origin);
}
